name: Kinesis Silver
oneLiner: Ethereum KAG is KMS Labs' silver-linked token, backed by native Kinesis KAG; physical redemption requires conversion, and reserve income stays with the issuer.
collateral: Investment-grade physical silver bullion (1 KAG = 1 troy ounce)
pegMechanism: KMS Labs' ERC-20 KAG is backed 1:1 by Kinesis-native KAG after compliance onboarding; native KAG is then redeemable for allocated physical silver through Kinesis Cayman. ERC-20 balances do not accrue Kinesis transaction-fee yield.

proofOfReserves.provider: Bureau Veritas Commodities UK Ltd (Inspectorate International; commodity vault inspection under agreed procedures with no opinion - the token-vs-metal comparison exists only in the issuer cover letter, whose signatory heads both Kinesis and the vault operator ABX)

latestReport.reviewer: PoR verification sweep 2026-08 (reconciliation set to none: the token-vs-metal comparison appears only in the issuer cover letter, not in Bureau Veritas's findings)

notices.title: MiCA assessment withdrawn pending token-specific legal evidence
notices.message: On 2026-10-01 Pharos withdrew the prior non-compliant ART assessment, whose references included an ESMA ART-register search dated 2026-08-14. Register absence, KMS Labs' token terms and Kinesis platform currency support do not establish a token-specific regulator or competent legal determination. KAG is now not assessed under MiCA; this does not assert EU authorization or erase the prior assessment. The original source record is preserved in the dated curation findings.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The Ethereum KAG deployment is a KMS Labs representation backed 1:1 by native Kinesis KAG, which is backed by allocated silver. KMS Labs terms expressly deny ERC-20 holders legal, equitable or beneficial title to its reserves and make redemption into native KAG discretionary. The existing commodity-claim archetype is retained; direct bullion title and physical redemption apply to the native parent rather than this Ethereum claim.
